answer: I would anchor trust in Interaction diversity score across unrelated peers. With talking to fifty strangers, not five friends, a single lantern check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since talking to fifty strangers, not five friends takes calendar time as well as money — and the ivory is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the relic of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
